entry.title: New: dsh-tool-generate-image
entry.summary: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work. Exact install spec: dsh-tool-generate-image. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
